 Sidestep (अस्पष्ट रूप से बचना) - To avoid or evade something, especially by clever or indirect means.

 Leisure (अवकाश) - Free time or relaxation time, especially when one is not working.

 Reprieve (अवकाश) - A temporary relief or suspension of something unpleasant, such as a punishment or obligation.

 Confront (सामना करना) - To face or deal with a difficult situation or person directly and boldly.

questions.solution_en:
 Awe (आश्चर्य) - A feeling of respect mixed with fear or wonder, often inspired by something impressive or powerful.

 Plunder (लूट) - To steal goods or valuables forcibly, typically during a time of war or civil disorder.

 Prompt (प्रोत्साहित करना) - To encourage or inspire someone to take action; to urge or incite.

 Obnoxious (अप्रिय) - Extremely unpleasant or offensive; deserving strong disapproval.

questions.q_hi:
Choose the most Appropriate ANTONYM of the Given Word –

REPUGNANT
questions.solution_en:
 Repugnant (घृणित) - Extremely distasteful; causing intense dislike or disgust.

 Pleasing (प्रिय) - Giving pleasure or satisfaction; agreeable or enjoyable.

 Gruesome (भयानक) - Extremely unpleasant or shocking, typically due to involving death or injury.

 Shriek (चिल्लाना) - To make a loud, sharp cry or sound, often out of fear, pain, or excitement.

 Palatial (महल समान) - Resembling or suitable for a palace; magnificent or grand in scale or appearance.
